title: Long-Span Question-Answering: Automatic Question Generation and QA-System Ranking via Side-by-Side Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting a 2x2 factorial experiment where different LLMs (Gemini 1.5 Pro and GPT-4 Turbo) generate answers to the same questions, and then each model acts as an auto-rater to evaluate the answers side-by-side to determine if they preferentially rank their own outputs higher.
